There are always those in the universe who pursue foods that would never occur naturally, such as the Antinomy Sandwich. The Quantum History School claims it is the power of "Equilibrium" that frames everything in its rightful place; the Structuralist Baking School, however, argues that this means it can be used as a burger bun. After several unobservable experiments, the Baking School produced this sandwich. It never falls to the ground, much like the effect of tying a cat and a buttered toast back-to-back together. As for what the "bread" actually is, some say it's just a shape, some say it's a topological structure, and others say it's the severed hands of a certain Arbitrator. What is certain is that all the experimenters have permanently sacrificed a part of themselves.

"After all, making a sandwich brings people peace. And if you release the binding energy of all the atoms in a sandwich, it can level a mountain."
